report.explanation: Alert shows four checkout observations, three fast (~60-78ms) and one 344ms, all HTTP 200. Traces, logs, and metrics show no errors, no 5xx, and healthy dependency calls; the single slow sample is not established as a fault. No current evidence supports any taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration). Historical references are advisory only. Insufficient evidence to bound a candidate; handing off for more data.
